mechanicalDifferences.title: A model badge does not identify the engine
mechanicalDifferences.summary: 318i includes M10/M40 and a U.S. M42 branch; 316 and 316i also have different fuel/engine branches.
mechanicalDifferences.implementation: Match engine, build month, market and installed hardware before sharing a procedure or catalog position.

mechanicalDifferences.title: The two generations use different AWD systems
mechanicalDifferences.summary: E30 325iX has permanent 37:63 AWD with viscous locking. The E34 525iX system uses electronically controlled locking and a 36:64 base split.
mechanicalDifferences.implementation: Distinct transfer-case, front-axle, driveline and diagnostic applicability; no automatic E30/E34 iX interchange.

mechanicalDifferences.title: 324d and 324td are separate diesel branches
mechanicalDifferences.summary: 324d is naturally aspirated M21D24; 324td adds turbocharging and DDE. Petrol procedures are not substitutes.
mechanicalDifferences.implementation: Diesel injection/glow systems and turbo-specific components need their own sources and procedures.

mechanicalDifferences.title: S14 does not imply M3 body fitment
mechanicalDifferences.summary: 320is is an Italian-market 1990 cc S14 model with standard-width two-/four-door forms; M3 and its evolutions require separate references.
mechanicalDifferences.implementation: Do not transfer M3 panels, brake packages or special-edition engine parts to every S14 or E30.

mechanicalDifferences.title: Body and build date change the part source
mechanicalDifferences.summary: Two-/four-door saloons, Touring and convertibles have separate contexts; the front-body source includes a September 1987 changeover.
mechanicalDifferences.implementation: Preserve body and original production restrictions instead of copying a whole-year fitment label.

mechanicalDifferences.title: M20 timing hardware remains explicit
mechanicalDifferences.summary: The manufacturer-listed manual includes M20 timing-belt work; dealer catalog data distinguishes belt tooth/profile variants.
mechanicalDifferences.implementation: Never substitute another engine’s timing service, belt profile, tensioner or tightening figures.

mechanicalDifferences.title: Market support is a configuration fact
mechanicalDifferences.summary: BMW’s UK history says its original E30 range was RWD; its U.S. history dates U.S. 325iX availability to 1988.
mechanicalDifferences.implementation: Do not generate the Cartesian product of every model/body/steering/market/gearbox as factory configurations.
